scopes.label: View organization
scopes.description: View organization settings and members.

scopes.label: Exception: view organization
scopes.description: Store exceptions for organization read access.

scopes.label: Manage organization
scopes.description: Manage organization settings, members, roles and access. Includes removing members and changing what every role can do.

scopes.label: Exception: manage organization
scopes.description: Store exceptions for organization admin access.

scopes.label: Sync device agent plugins
scopes.description: Let an agent's device agent sync the plugins assigned to it.

scopes.label: Send hook events
scopes.description: Let an agent send AI-tool hook events and telemetry.

scopes.label: Connect to Channels
scopes.description: Connect to Channels and exchange messages as an authorized instance.

scopes.label: Manage Channels
scopes.description: Manage Channels settings and member access without reading other members' messages.

scopes.label: Read all Channels messages
scopes.description: Read other members' private Channels conversations in the project.

scopes.label: View projects
scopes.description: View projects and project-related resources.

scopes.label: Exception: view projects
scopes.description: Store exceptions for project read access.

scopes.label: Manage projects
scopes.description: Create and modify projects and project-related resources.

scopes.label: Exception: manage projects
scopes.description: Store exceptions for project write access.

scopes.label: View MCP servers
scopes.description: View MCP servers and their configuration.

scopes.label: Exception: view MCP servers
scopes.description: Store exceptions for MCP read access.

scopes.label: Manage MCP servers
scopes.description: Create, change and delete MCP servers and their configuration.

scopes.label: Exception: manage MCP servers
scopes.description: Store exceptions for MCP write access.

scopes.label: Connect to MCP servers
scopes.description: Connect to MCP servers and call their tools.

scopes.label: Exception: connect to MCP servers
scopes.description: Store exceptions for MCP connect access.

scopes.label: Use shared auth clients
scopes.description: Use an upstream auth client to reach MCP servers. Applies on every server that shares the client.

scopes.label: Exception: use shared auth clients
scopes.description: Store exceptions for auth client use.

scopes.label: View environments
scopes.description: View environments and their entries within the project, including secret values.

scopes.label: Exception: view environments
scopes.description: Store exceptions for environment read access.

scopes.label: Manage environments
scopes.description: Add, edit, clone, and remove environments within the project.

scopes.label: Exception: manage environments
scopes.description: Store exceptions for environment write access.

scopes.label: View skills
scopes.description: View skills within the project.

scopes.label: Exception: view skills
scopes.description: Store exceptions for skill read access.

scopes.label: Manage skills
scopes.description: Create and modify skills within the project.

scopes.label: Exception: manage skills
scopes.description: Store exceptions for skill write access.

scopes.label: Publish plugins
scopes.description: Manage plugin contents and publish plugins within the project, without editing referenced skills or MCP servers.

scopes.label: Exception: publish plugins
scopes.description: Store exceptions for plugin write access.

scopes.label: View assistants
scopes.description: View and interact with assistants within the project.

scopes.label: Exception: view assistants
scopes.description: Store exceptions for assistant read access.

scopes.label: Manage assistants
scopes.description: Create and modify assistants within the project.

scopes.label: Exception: manage assistants
scopes.description: Store exceptions for assistant write access.

scopes.label: Evaluate risk policies
scopes.description: Put the holder in the named risk policy's audience, so the policy is evaluated against their requests unless a bypass grant for the same policy exempts the request.

scopes.label: Bypass risk policies
scopes.description: Exempt the holder from the named risk policy for the exact server the grant names, by URL or identity. It only subtracts from a matching evaluate grant and never puts anyone in a policy's audience.

scopes.label: Block shadow MCP servers
scopes.description: Block specific shadow MCP servers under allow-by-default risk policies.

scopes.label: View agent sessions
scopes.description: Read and pin other members' agent session transcripts, and reveal secrets flagged in Risk Events. Everyone keeps their own sessions.

scopes.label: Manage agent sessions
scopes.description: Rename, delete, and give feedback on other members' agent sessions, and read their transcripts. Everyone keeps their own.

scopes.label: Run inference
scopes.description: Run model inference without accessing chat transcripts.

scopes.label: View tool logs
scopes.description: View every member's tool-call logs and traces in the project, including tool arguments, results, and prompt text. Everyone keeps the logs of their own sessions and of agents they own. Not implied by project or organization admin access.

scopes.label: View agents
scopes.description: View agents and their settings.

scopes.label: Manage agents
scopes.description: Create, configure, and manage agents.

scopes.label: Authorize agent credentials
scopes.description: Authorize agents and manage their credentials.

scopes.label: Transfer agent ownership
scopes.description: Hand an agent to another owner. The previous owner loses control of it.

scopes.label: View workload identities
scopes.description: View workload identity trust policy: issuers, admitted subjects, and assigned agents.

scopes.label: Exception: view workload identities
scopes.description: Store exceptions for workload read access.

scopes.label: Manage workload identities
scopes.description: Register workload issuers, admit and withdraw subjects, and assign agents to workloads.

scopes.label: Exception: manage workload identities
scopes.description: Store exceptions for workload write access.
